item.label: Hover Over Tooltip
item.description: Tooltip allowing you to hover over and click inside it.

item.label: Tooltip Hover Area
item.description: Determines the size of the invisible border around the tooltip that will prevent it from hiding if the cursor left it.

item.label: Tooltip Content Delay [ms]
item.description: Determines the time in ms to show the Tooltip content when triggger.

item.label: Tooltip Content Hide Delay
item.description: Determines the time in ms to debounce the Tooltip content hide handler when the cursor leaves.

item.label: Max Width
item.description: Specifies the maximum width of the tooltip. Useful to prevent it from being too horizontally wide to read.

item.label: Tooltip Distance
item.description: Displaces the tippy from its reference element in pixels (skidding and distance).

item.label: Tooltip Horizontal Position
item.description: Tooltip horizontal distance length from element to tooltip.

item.label: Tooltip Vertical Position
item.description: Tooltip vertical distance length from spot to tooltip
